description.zh: 连接后可查询建设中的技能需求、申请上传地址提交技能包、查询提交审核状态。你做好的技能包，只要通过两道关（安全检查 + 公益价值评审），就能连同测试和评审结果一起，存进腾讯技术公益数字工具箱的公益技能库，有机会分享给更多公益伙伴使用。
description.en: Once connected, you can query in-progress skill requirements, request an upload address to submit your skill package, and check submission review status. A skill package that passes both checks (security review and public welfare value assessment) can be added, together with its test and evaluation results, to the public welfare skill library within the Tencent Tech for Good Digital Toolbox.
